source: Pointed channel source (Z^{D_n}, j), D_n the actual polygon diagonal set; j is an explicitly supplied diagonal occurrence, not a canonically chosen channel.
selection: R_j c(k)=c(k e_j); E_j b=sum_k b(k) delta_{k e_j}
reconstruction: c=E_j R_j c+N_j c, N_j=I-E_j R_j; full off-axis data and mark retained.
domain: Axis subalgebra for arbitrary binary convolution; whole coefficient space only for the listed kernel-stable unary operations.
symmetry_policy: R_{sigma(j)} sigma_* = R_j; permutations act on both source and mark. Fixed-mark symmetry is the stabilizer of j.
licensed_operations: channel relabelling with simultaneous mark transport
excluded_operations: unrestricted binary convolution of whole-source packets through the reader
moving a channel while freezing its mark
discarding archives or restoring them as an unreviewed task operation
refinement: h->h/2, n->2n; mark unchanged; R_j and E_j commute with bonding and additive atom positions stay fixed.
quadratic: Q(n)=sum n_d^2 restricts to Q(k e_j)=k^2 with unchanged declared heat scale.
Fourier_lattice_square: F_D E_j b(theta)=F_1 b(theta_j); normalized transverse torus factors are constant one.
real_fourier_charts: Even charts embed T as T tensor delta_0(transverse); odd charts embed T as T tensor 1(transverse). F_D switches these charts and applies F_1; they are not the same ambient distribution.
theta: At h=1 the marked unit axis comb pairs with the D-dimensional Gaussian as theta_1(t). Transverse delta/constant Fourier exchange cancels the extra D-1 Gaussian integration factors, giving the one-dimensional reciprocity exponent.
symmetric_alternative: Sigma(n)=sum n_d preserves addition, permutations and bonding on finite packets, but Q does not descend, fibre summation is not bounded on l2 for D>=2 and the full unweighted comb has infinite fibre mass.
